name: configure_developer
description: One-time (or explicit-update) developer commissioning for this plugin workspace: records the email, display name, and optional public GitHub repo URL that generate_plugin_scaffold stamps into every server_entry.json's developer/author fields, for every plugin generated under this plugin_output_root -- not a per-plugin step. Always call get_developer_config first: only call this tool if that returned configured: false, or generate_plugin_scaffold's error says no developer config exists yet, or the person explicitly asked to change the identity on file. Do not call this defensively at the start of a new plugin/conversation just because you can't recall an earlier session's commissioning -- doing so silently overwrites whatever correct identity is already on file. The email given must match this session's own authenticated identity when one is known -- refuses on an actual mismatch. Never invent or guess the developer's email/name; ask the person directly.

email.description: The developer's email address. Must match this session's own authenticated identity, when one is known, or the call is refused.

name.description: The developer's display name -- stamped into every generated server_entry.json's 'author' field.

github_url.description: Optional public GitHub repository URL for this developer. Omit if they don't have one or it isn't public.

default_run_as.description: Optional OS account every generated plugin's server_entry.json uses as its 'runAs' fallback, unless a given plugin's own server_entry.runAs overrides it. Omit to keep the tool's own built-in default ('admin').
